title: Rethinking Contrastive Targets in Radiology Language-Image Pretraining
abstract: arXiv:2611.24016v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: CLIP-style contrastive image-text pretraining is widely used in radiology data, where each image is paired with one report and every other report in the batch is treated as a negative. Under this recipe, two failures appear, neither of which is systematically addressed by existing contrastive learning theory: zero-shot evaluation peaks then degrades while training loss keeps decreasing, and training fails to learn from large batches. We hypothesize the cause is structural rather than radiology-specific: many unpaired reports share clinical findings with a given image, so CLIP's paired-identity target is systematically biased, not merely noisy. To test this, we construct CLEVR-Radiology, a synthetic testbed that preserves only this overlapping-fact structure and reproduces both failures. translated_title: 重新思考放射学语言-图像预训练中的对比学习目标
translated_abstract: CLIP式的对比图文预训练被广泛应用于放射学数据中，其中每张图像与一份报告配对，而批次中所有其他报告都被视为负样本。在这种方案下会出现两种失败现象，而现有的对比学习理论均未系统地解决它们：零样本评估性能先上升后下降，而训练损失却在持续下降；以及训练无法从大批量数据中学习。我们假设其原因在于结构性问题，而非放射学领域特有的问题：许多未配对的报告与给定图像共享相同的临床发现，因此CLIP的配对身份目标存在系统性偏倚，而不仅仅是噪声。为验证这一假设，我们构建了CLEVR-Radiology，一个仅保留这种重叠事实结构的合成测试平台，并成功复现了上述两种失败现象。在有证据表明该结构足以复现失败现象之后，我们发展了一种目标错定理论，从…解释了这两种失败现象（原文摘要至此截断）。
tldr: 该论文指出放射学CLIP式对比预训练中零样本性能先升后降及大批量训练失效的根源在于目标错定——大量未配对报告与图像共享临床发现导致配对身份目标存在系统性偏倚，作者通过合成测试平台CLEVR-Radiology复现了这些失败并建立了相应的目标错定理论加以解释。
en_tdlr: The paper shows that zero-shot degradation and large-batch training failure in CLIP-style radiology pretraining stem from target misspecification—unpaired reports sharing clinical findings with a given image introduce systematic bias—a structure reproduced on the synthetic testbed CLEVR-Radiology and explained by a target-misspecification theory.
